$Comment: Zone 1 is where a player meets their first talus, so the pair here are the two softest, with copper three times as likely as iron.

Environments covers every open surface zone 1 has, not just the plains tiles. Env_Zone1_Plains matches only the handful of tiles literally named Plains, and the noise patches that overwrite the surface with Env_Zone1_Encounters punch holes even in those, so gating on it alone leaves most of zone 1 unmatched. Swamps and shores are left out as wet ground and beach.

The plains are covered by Zone1_Plains, which spawns this same pair plus the temple. An environment may only be claimed by one rule, so the plains needs a rule of its own rather than an extra line here.
